name: Browser Run
summary: Browser Run, formerly Browser Rendering, runs headless Chrome instances on Cloudflare's network. Quick Actions return Markdown, screenshots, PDFs or scraped data from a single HTTP request, while Browser Sessions are driven with Puppeteer, Playwright, CDP or Stagehand. The Agents SDK browser tool keeps a remote browser open across turns, with a live view for human takeover.
facts: Quick Actions, Puppeteer, Playwright, CDP, Stagehand, MCP
Persistent sessions, Live View, rrweb session recording
10 browser minutes per day, 3 concurrent browsers
10 browser hours/month included, then $0.09/hour; $2.00 per extra concurrent browser
goodFor: Agents built on Workers and the Agents SDK
One-shot page reads to Markdown or screenshots
Handing logins or CAPTCHAs to a person via live view
watchOut: Persistent agent browsers support only the Chromium engine
Idle agent browsers close after about 10 minutes by default
